android.desc:
Take control of your nutrition with Macros. Whether you're looking to lose weight, build muscle, or maintain a healthier lifestyle, Macros makes tracking simple and effective. Enter your profile details, and we'll calculate a personalized daily calorie goal and macro breakdown tailored to your fitness objectives.

Macros is designed to help you build sustainable habits, regardless of your experience level or dietary preferences. Manage your food diary, plan meals, and track macros, activities, and hydration effortlessly. Stay on top of your goals, even on the busiest days, with flexible and intuitive calorie and macro counting.

Features:

- Calculate your caloric needs for weight loss, muscle gain, or maintenance.
- Food tracker for calories and macros (carbohydrates, protein and fats).
- Net carbohydrate counter—perfect for ketogenic or low-carb diets.
- Calculate calories from macros to ensure that calories and macros always match.
- Extensive food database.
- Barcode scanner for easy logging.
- Record daily exercises and activities.
- Water intake tracker.
- Custom food creation.
- Build your own recipe library.

Macros Plus, available via subscription, takes your tracking to the next level:

- Set macro goals by grams or percentages.
- Customize micronutrient goals.
- Meal timing—track when you eat.
- Plan meals up to 30 days in advance.
- Sync with external apps like Fitbit and Garmin.
- Tailored daily goals for carb cycling or training/rest days.
- Identify top contributors to your calorie, macro, and micronutrient intake.
- Monitor progress with monthly intake graphs.
- Export your daily meals to printable PDFs.
- Add daily notes to your log.
- Ad-free experience.

Macros is free to download and use. Optionally, you can upgrade to Plus to unlock amazing additional features. Subscriptions are auto-renewing but can be canceled at any time, up to 24 hours before the end of the current period.

Terms of Service: https://macros.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://macros.app/privacy

This is a great question! This was something I was stuck on for a long time.

I used to think this would be an extremely time-consuming thing that would be very annoying to learn. What really struck me is how easy this actually turned out to be. In fact tracking what you eat will save you time. Here's how.

People talk about "counting calories". But here's the problem with that: you can eat nothing but donuts throughout the day and stay within your calorie limit, yet it's still unhealthy. What gives? How do we know what is healthy and what isn't?

Enter macros. Calories in food are made up of three "macros", which are: fat; carbs; protein.

So just forget about calories. What you want to know is how many macros you need per day; how many grams of fat, grams of protein, and grams of carbs. The calories will work themselves out.

Okay, how do you find out? Super easy. You can use a calculator like this one: https://www.bodybuilding.com/fun/macronutrients_calculator.htm

For me, every day I aim for:

154g Carbs

150g Protein

32g Fat

Now you might be thinking "Wow that sounds like a pain in the ass to track. How is it even possible to track that?"

There are apps that do this for you. My favorite app is called "Macros" https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.josmantek.macros&hl=en_US&gl=US and there are a lot of other good ones out there.

Here's how it works:
